title: Connection Recognized as a 2026 Dell Technologies Titanium Black Partner
summary: MERRIMACK, N.H. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 1, 2026-- Connection ( PC Connection, Inc.; NASDAQ: CNXN), a leading provider of information technology solutions to business, government, healthcare, and education markets, is proud to announce it has achieved Dell Technologies Partner Program Titanium Black
body_markdown:
MERRIMACK, N.H.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 1, 2026-- Connection (PC Connection, Inc.; NASDAQ:[CNXN](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.connection.com%2F&esheet=54476085&newsitemid=20260401535112&lan=en-US&anchor=CNXN&index=1&md5=796794f1ea460da6b90d70f941dd122a) ), a leading provider of information technology solutions to business, government, healthcare, and education markets, is proud to announce it has achieved Dell Technologies Partner Program Titanium Black status for 2026.


Titanium Black represents the highest status in the Dell Technologies Partner Program. This distinction recognizes Connection among an elite group of Dell’s most strategic partners best equipped to navigate today’s rapidly evolving technology landscape and support their customers in achieving transformative outcomes.


“Our robust partner ecosystem is one of our greatest strengths, and its impact is measured by the tangible results we deliver for customers,” said Denise Millard, chief partner officer, Dell Technologies. “We are pleased to welcome Connection as a 2026 Dell Technologies Titanium Black partner. This collaboration deepens our collective ability to support customers as they tackle today's challenges and plan for tomorrow.”


“Achieving Titanium Black status is a significant milestone for Connection and a testament to the expertise and dedication of our teams,” said Tim McGrath, President and CEO of Connection. “Our relationship with Dell Technologies is built on a shared commitment to innovation and customer success. This recognition reinforces our ability to deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions that help our customers solve their most complex business challenges and achieve superior long-term outcomes. Thank you to Dell Technologies for this honor—and for collaborating with Connection to advance the technology goals of our mutual customers.”


**About Connection**


[Connection](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.connection.com%2F&esheet=54476085&newsitemid=20260401535112&lan=en-US&anchor=Connection&index=2&md5=b87fecec45b63f94ec3eeceff8588179) , a Fortune 1000 company, calms the confusion of IT by delivering customers industry-leading technology solutions to enhance growth, elevate productivity, and empower innovation. Since 1982, Connection’s culture of simplifying technology for people has set new standards for customer service and loyalty, earning the industry’s highest accolades. Connection offers expertise across multiple technology areas, including AI, cybersecurity, data center, digital workspace, multicloud, and technology services.
